Market today:
The mood is mixed, with inflation concerns (UK data) potentially clashing with strategist optimism about stocks advancing post-Fed hike. This creates uncertainty for your tech/chip names, which are sensitive to interest rates.

Your holdings:
SOXL (-59.15%) and SPAL (-31.41%) are major red flags. Both are leveraged, decaying ETFs with stops far above current prices, indicating significant downside. QQQ (-1.39%) and SMH (-14.27%) are also on 'TRIM' status, needing attention. Remember, margin amplifies these drops.

Watch:
Keep a close eye on any further inflation data or Fed commentary. Also, monitor your leveraged positions for any signs of further decay or if their stops become relevant.

Bottom line:
Prioritize risk management on your leveraged positions; they're bleeding capital fast.
plays: SOXL: This leveraged ETF is down 59.15% with a stop at 200 (current 103.97). Re-evaluate your stop or consider trimming this position immediately to stem further decay and capital loss.
SPAL: Similar to SOXL, this leveraged ETF is down 31.41% with a stop at 21.38 (current 17.25). Adjust your stop or trim to manage risk from decay and potential further drops.
QQQ/SMH: Both are on 'TRIM' status. Consider reducing exposure, especially in SMH (-14.27%), to free up capital and reduce overall tech concentration. No new buys today - hold and watch.
